Genuine separately compiled Kotlin parent and generic compatibility-child output
retain two independently scoped own-formal seed/result contracts. Function2
parameter order differs between foldIn and foldOut. Raw static accessors must
keep exact descriptors and absent Signatures; Parent and DefaultImpls keep their
original method formals and variance. A private helper uses the same certified
erased invocation binding without importing a foreign formal into its scope.

Frozen observers verify arbitrary/null/aliased seeds and results, both argument
orders, lexical default calls versus virtual overrides, raw results unrelated to
the seed's runtime class, exception identity and partial trace effects through
four routes. Both source and SDK-trace profiles compile all emitted Java and
compare complete metadata and Exceptions. Exact SourceFile and class-version
52-to-53 differences are recorded for the reported Java 9 private helpers.
